caption: The drawing depicts a single, dark-colored, three-pronged object positioned centrally on an off-white or light beige background. The object consists of three thick, black or dark brown curved lines, which join together at a single point near the bottom center of the image, then extend upwards and curve outwards to the left and right before turning slightly downward at both ends. Each of the two side prongs concludes with a short, flat, horizontal segment. The central prong is slightly longer and maintains a straight direction. There are no other objects, details, or background elements present in the drawing except for a small signature or inscription in the bottom right corner, reading "C.W. Dawson," along with another faint line of text below it.
title: Trivet
